SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.ID LINKROWID ,S.DOCNUM ,DOCGRP.OPTDES DOCGRP ,DOCSTA.OPTDES DOCSTA ,WFLSTA.OPTDES WFLSTA ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.DOCDAT, 23) DOCDAT ,S.DOCDES ,S.PRJNUM ,SI.SITENAM SITE ,S.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,S.CUR ,S.CURRAT --汇率 ,S.RESNO --采购员 ,S.CONTNOI --百隆合同号 ,S.CONTNOE --合同号 ,S.LCNO --信用证号 ,S.REMARK ,S1.NAME + '(' + S.CREUSR + ')' CREUSR ,S2.NAME + '(' + S.UPDUSR + ')' UPDUSR ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.CRETIM, 21) CRETIM ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) UPDTIM FROM PORDER S LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS ON S.BPSNO = BPS.BPSNO LEFT JOIN ENTSITE SI ON SI.SITE = S.SITE LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCGRP ON DOCGRP.OPTID = S.DOCGRP AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'POR' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT WFLSTA ON WFLSTA.OPTID = S.WFLSTA AND WFLSTA.OPTTYP = 'WFLSTA' LEFT JOIN LINK.DBO.SYSUSER USR ON S.CREUSR = USR.LOGINUSER LEFT JOIN LINK.DBO.SysUser S1 ON S.CREUSR = S1.LoginUser LEFT JOIN LINK.DBO.SysUser S2 ON S.UPDUSR = S2.LoginUser WHERE ( S.CREUSR = N'#LOGIN_USER#' --用户自己 OR '#LINKUSER(#LOGIN_USER#).DOCGRP#' = '' OR Charindex(USR.UDF001, '#LINKUSER(#LOGIN_USER#).DOCGRP#') > 0 ) --用户组权限 AND S.DOCNUM + S.DOCDES + S.PRJNUM + S.BPSNO + S.REMARK + S.BVATTYP + S.CONTNOI + S.CONTNOE + S.CONTDES + S.LCNO + S.BPSNO + Isnull(BPS.BPSNAM, '') LIKE '%{0}%' AND ( ( S.DOCDAT BETWEEN '{1}' AND '{2}' ) OR ( '{1}' = '' AND '{2}' = '' ) ) AND S.DOCSTA LIKE '%{3}%' AND (S.CREUSR='{4}' OR '{4}'='') ORDER BY S.ID DESC
